# Research: Context Window and Output Token Limits for Claude and GPT Models

I have direct web search results for Claude models. For GPT models, I did not receive web search results, so I will need to be transparent about what I can and cannot cite.

---

## Claude Models — Sourced from Official Documentation

### API Context Windows

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window." | CLAIM: The listed Claude models each support a 1M-token context window via the API.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window." | CLAIM: Claude Sonnet 4.5 and other unlisted models have a 200k-token context window.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "A single request to any of them can generate up to 128k output tokens (`max_tokens`)." | CLAIM: The maximum output tokens per API request for the 1M-context models is 128,000 tokens.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "For every model with a 1M-token context window, 1M is the default: you don't need a beta header, and long-context requests are billed at standard pricing." | CLAIM: The 1M context window is the default for those models; no special opt-in is needed.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "A single request can include up to 600 images or PDF pages (100 for models with a 200k-token context window)." | CLAIM: 1M-context models accept up to 600 images or PDF pages per request; 200k-context models accept up to 100.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "If the input alone already exceeds the model's context window, the API returns a 400 `invalid_request_error` ('prompt is too long') on every model." | CLAIM: The API rejects requests whose input alone exceeds the context window.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows.md | QUOTE: "On Claude 4.5 models and newer, if input tokens plus `max_tokens` exceeds the context window size, the API accepts the request. If generation then reaches the context window limit, it stops with `stop_reason: "model_context_window_exceeded"`." | CLAIM: On Claude 4.5+ models, the API tolerates combined input+output exceeding the window by truncating generation, rather than rejecting the request outright.

### Claude Help Center (Consumer Plans)

SOURCE: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606395-how-large-is-the-claude-api-s-context-window | QUOTE: "The Claude API can ingest 1M tokens when using Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 5, or Sonnet 4.6, and 200K+ tokens (about 500 pages of text or more) when using all other models." | CLAIM: The Help Center confirms the same 1M vs. 200K+ split for the API.

SOURCE: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606394-how-large-is-the-context-window-on-paid-claude-plans | QUOTE: "Outside of these models, Claude's context window size is 200K, meaning it can ingest 200K+ tokens (about 500 pages of text or more) when using a paid Claude plan to chat with Claude." | CLAIM: On paid consumer plans (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise), models not in the 1M/500K list default to a 200K-token context window.

SOURCE: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11647753-how-do-usage-and-length-limits-work | QUOTE: "On paid plans, the newest models support up to a 1M token context window, while others support 500K or 200K tokens. A portion of the context window is always reserved for Claude's response, so the longest possible conversation is slightly smaller than the full window." | CLAIM: The usable context for input is slightly less than the full window because space is reserved for the model's response.

---

## GPT Models — What I Can and Cannot Cite

I did not receive web search results for OpenAI's documentation. I will now state plainly what I know versus what I could find a quotable source for.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: I could not retrieve and quote an official OpenAI documentation page stating the exact context window size for GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4, GPT-3.5 Turbo, or any other current GPT model.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: I could not retrieve and quote an official OpenAI documentation page stating the exact maximum output token limit for GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, or other GPT models.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: I could not retrieve and quote an official OpenAI documentation page listing per-model token limits in a structured table (their platform.openai.com/docs/models page or equivalent).

**What I know from training data (not quotable sources, subject to staleness):** As of my last training data, OpenAI's GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini were documented as having a 128K context window and a maximum of 16,384 output tokens per request. GPT-4 Turbo was also 128K context. GPT-3.5 Turbo was 16K context. OpenAI's o1 and o3 reasoning models had different limits (e.g., o1 had a 200K context window with up to 100K output tokens). However, these numbers may have changed since my training data, and I cannot provide a word-for-word quote from a live OpenAI page to confirm them today.

---

## Uncertain / Gaps

1. **GPT model limits**: All GPT numbers above come from training data, not from a live source I can quote. They may be outdated or incorrect for the latest models. I recommend checking [platform.openai.com/docs/models](https://platform.openai.com/docs/models) directly for current figures.

2. **Claude output token limits for non-1M models**: The search results mention 128K output tokens specifically for the 1M-context models. The output token limit for 200K-context models (e.g., Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5) is not explicitly stated in the quotes I received. The docs say "Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window" but don't separately quote their output token cap in my search results. I believe from training data that Sonnet 4.5 supports up to 64K output tokens and Haiku 4.5 up to 64K, but I cannot quote a source line for that here.

3. **Newer Claude models (Fable, Mythos lines)**: These appear in the documentation quotes I received but I have no training-data context about what these models are or their positioning. I can only report what the quotes say about their context window size.

4. **Claude consumer plan context windows vs. API**: The consumer plan help article shows a more granular breakdown (500K for some models, 1M for others, with notes about compacting and `/model` selection) that differs slightly from the flat API numbers. I quoted what I received but the full table was truncated in the search results, so some entries may be incomplete.
